primary_sources.locations: Section3.2 Eq5 and Table4 zero/one initialization

source_summary: ResFormer mixes first-layer values into later-layer values before the CURRENT layer attention. The paper includes a zero/one initialization ablation. Its English pretraining/larger-model validation losses do not establish Japanese10M continuation quality.
motivation: Latest comparison passes grammar threshold but has2 coherent/2 appropriate of80. Test an earlier-token-information path across layers rather than another attention-map, decoding, data or auxiliary-objective adjustment. No local causal diagnosis of value loss or attention concentration is claimed.

architecture.formula: layer0 V unchanged; for layers1..12 mixed_V_l = native_V_l + alpha_l * native_V_0; original Q_l/K_l attention acts on mixed_V_l
architecture.alpha_parameterization: direct signed trainable scalar; no tanh/sigmoid/clamp
architecture.first_value_source: original layer0 input RMSNorm then original layer0 v_proj; pre-GQA-repeat and unrotated
architecture.past_value_cache: cache each layer mixed V; first layer caches original V; mix only current new-token values before appending past
architecture.export: separate tagged full research checkpoint; native/HF export must refuse until explicit adapter exists

difference_from_paper: Own adaptation: first layer has no redundant scalar, current-V coefficient fixed1, only later-layer additive coefficients learned from0. Retains native RMSNorm/GQA. Not exact ResFormer reproduction or cache-compression SVFormer.

difference_from_closed.cross_GQA: No cross-head map subtraction or second attention map; changes V across layers under the original map.
difference_from_closed.headwise_gate: No input-dependent query-head sigmoid/output gating or O rescaling.
difference_from_closed.parallel_residual: Original attention-then-MLP block order preserved; adds first-layer V path, not parallel hidden residual.
difference_from_closed.objectives: Only unchanged original body+EOS CE; no pseudo repetition/context likelihood loss.
